tools.name: search_ai_training_jobs
tools.description: Search the open AI training jobs (paid work training and evaluating AI models) across about 60 platforms such as Mercor, micro1, Outlier, DataAnnotation, Alignerr and Invisible. Returns each role's title, platform, kind of work, advertised pay, where it is open and a link to apply on AITraining.jobs

tools.name: get_ai_training_pay
tools.description: What AI training work pays per hour today, by kind of work: the median and the typical range (25th to 75th percentile) of the rates open roles advertise, with how many rates and platforms each figure comes from. A rate is shown only when at least three platforms advertise it.

tools.name: get_ai_training_market
tools.description: How many AI training jobs are open right now, how many were listed in the last 7 days, and the open roles by kind of work and by platform (with each platform's slug for search_ai_training_jobs). Optionally scoped to the roles open to applicants in one country.
